_: What the Swift and Kotlin packages can do with a workbook, a deck and a PDF (documents are in catalog.json). Each method is written as a signature; types are string, int, double, bool, json, scalar (a string, number, boolean or null), T?, [T], map<T>, or the name of an enum or type of the editor. The engine (src/editors/*.ts) implements every method here and checks each call's arguments against it, and scripts/generate.mjs writes the typed Swift and Kotlin from it.

docs.doc: What a document has beyond the commands of catalog.json: comments anchored to text.

CommentRange.doc: Where a comment thread's text is now: a block, and a range of its text in UTF-16 units.

methods.doc: Starts a comment thread on the selected text, with `body` as its first comment, as one undo step. Returns nil when no text is selected. The thread's anchor is `{"block": …, "from": …, "to": …, "quote": …}`.
Where the thread's text is now, one range per block it covers; empty once the text is gone.
The threads attached to the text at the caret, or anywhere in the selection, in the order they were started.

sheets.doc: A workbook: sheets of cells with formulas that recalculate, number formats, styles, tables and charts.

CellInfo.doc: A cell as it shows and as it was typed. `value` is what it is worth (null when empty or an error), `error` is the formula error such as `#DIV/0!`, `text` is the value with its number format, and `formula` is what was typed when it starts with `=`.

FoundCell.doc: A cell that has the text looked for.

methods.doc: The workbook's title.
Renames the workbook.
The sheets, in tab order.
Where the sheet has anything, as a range such as `A1:D20`, or nil when it is empty.
One cell: its value, how it shows and what was typed. `sheet` is a name (any case) or an id.
What the cell is worth: a number, text, true or false, nil for an empty cell, or `{"error": "#DIV/0!"}`.
The cell as it shows, with its number format applied.
The values of a range, row by row, as a list of lists.
A range as tab-separated text, as the clipboard has it.
A range as an HTML table, with its formatting.
The merged ranges of a sheet.

methods.sig: find(text: string, matchCase: bool?, wholeCell: bool?, sheet: string?): [FoundCell]
methods.doc: Finds cells that show the text, in one sheet or in every visible sheet. `*` stands for any text and `?` for any one character.

methods.sig: replace(text: string, replacement: string, matchCase: bool?, wholeCell: bool?, sheet: string?): ReplaceResult
methods.doc: Replaces text in what cells hold, as one undo step.

methods.sig: setCell(sheet: string, address: string, value: scalar): void
methods.doc: Types into a cell as a person would: text that starts with `=` is a formula, and numbers, dates and percentages in text become what they look like.
Types into several cells at once, keyed by address, as one undo step.

methods.sig: setValues(sheet: string, at: string, rows: json): void
methods.doc: Puts a block of values (a list of rows) with its top left at `at`.

methods.sig: clear(sheet: string, range: string, what: ClearWhat): void
methods.doc: Clears the contents, the formats, or both.

methods.sig: setFormat(sheet: string, range: string, format: string?): void
methods.doc: Sets the number format, such as `0.00`, `#,##0`, `0%` or `yyyy-mm-dd`; nil goes back to General.

methods.sig: setStyle(sheet: string, range: string, style: json): void
methods.doc: Changes the look of a range: `{"bold": true, "fill": "#ffeeaa", "color": "#222222", "align": "center"}`. A property set to null is removed.

methods.sig: fill(sheet: string, range: string, direction: FillDirection): void
methods.doc: Copies the first row (or column) of the range over the rest, moving the formulas' references.

methods.sig: autofill(sheet: string, source: string, target: string): void
methods.doc: Continues a series (1, 2, 3 or Monday, Tuesday) from the source range over the target.

methods.sig: copy(sheet: string, range: string, toSheet: string, at: string, cut: bool): void
methods.doc: Copies a range to where `at` is on another (or the same) sheet; with `cut`, it moves and formulas that point at it follow.

methods.sig: sort(sheet: string, range: string, by: int?, descending: bool?, header: bool?): void
methods.doc: Sorts the rows of a range by one column (1 is the range's first column, the default).

methods.sig: insertRows(sheet: string, at: int, count: int): void
methods.doc: Inserts rows before row `at` (1 is the first). Formulas that point at the rows after them follow.

methods.sig: deleteRows(sheet: string, at: int, count: int): void
methods.doc: Deletes rows; references to deleted cells become `#REF!`.

methods.sig: insertColumns(sheet: string, at: int, count: int): void
methods.doc: Inserts columns before column `at` (1 is A).

methods.sig: deleteColumns(sheet: string, at: int, count: int): void
methods.doc: Deletes columns.

methods.sig: setColumnWidth(sheet: string, column: int, width: double?): void
methods.doc: Sets a column's width in pixels (nil for the default); `column` is 1 for A.

methods.sig: setRowHeight(sheet: string, row: int, height: double?): void
methods.doc: Sets a row's height in pixels (nil for the default).

methods.sig: setFrozen(sheet: string, rows: int, cols: int): void
methods.doc: Freezes the top rows and left columns.
Merges a range into one cell.
Takes a merge apart.

methods.sig: setNote(sheet: string, address: string, text: string?): void
methods.doc: Puts a note on a cell, or takes it off with nil.
Puts filter buttons on the first row of a range, or takes the filter off with nil.
Defines a name that formulas can use (`=Tax*A1`), or removes it with nil.
Adds an empty sheet.
Deletes a sheet. The last sheet stays.
Renames a sheet; formulas that name it follow.
Moves a sheet's tab.
Colours a sheet's tab (`#rrggbb`), or clears it with nil.

methods.sig: insertChart(sheet: string, range: string, type: string?): json
methods.doc: Makes a chart from a range (the first row and column are labels) and returns it: type is `column`, `bar`, `line`, `area`, `pie`, `scatter` and the rest the chart types list.

methods.sig: commentOnRange(sheet: string, range: string, body: string, mentions: [string]?): Thread
methods.doc: Starts a comment thread on a cell or a range (`B3`, `B3:C5`). The thread's anchor is `{"sheet": <the sheet's id>, "range": "B3"}`, so it stays with the sheet when it is renamed.
The comment threads whose cell or range holds this cell, oldest first.
Undoes the last step.
Does the undone step again.

files.name: importXlsx
files.doc: Replaces the workbook with an .xlsx file. History starts again.

files.name: exportCsv
files.doc: One sheet as CSV text (UTF-8), formulas written as what they work out to. The first visible sheet by default.

files.name: importCsv
files.doc: Replaces the workbook with a sheet holding the CSV.

files.name: exportPdf
files.doc: One sheet as a PDF, paged as it prints (page setup, print area and titles).

decks.doc: A deck of slides: masters and layouts, text, shapes, pictures, tables and charts, with notes and transitions.

ElementInfo.doc: An element of a slide, layout or master. Position and size are in points; they are nil for a placeholder that takes them from its layout.

LayoutInfo.doc: A layout a slide can use.

DeckSize.doc: The size of the slides, in points.

methods.doc: The deck's title.
Renames the deck.
The size of the slides.

methods.sig: setSize(width: double, height: double, scale: bool): void
methods.doc: Changes the slide size; with `scale` the elements are scaled to fit.
The slides, in order.
The layouts of every master.
The elements of a slide (or a layout or master, by its id), from the back to the front.
A slide's speaker notes.

methods.sig: find(query: string, matchCase: bool?, notes: bool?): [DeckFindHit]
methods.doc: Finds text in the slides (and in the notes with `notes`).
Adds a slide from a layout (the first by default), after another slide (the end by default).
Duplicates slides; returns the new ids.
Deletes slides.
Moves slides so that the first lands at position `to` (0 is first).
Names a slide.
Sets the speaker notes.
Skips slides when presenting.
Gives a slide another layout; its placeholders follow.
Sets the background of slides to a fill (a colour such as `"#102040"` or `{"theme": "dk2"}`), or back to the layout's with nil.
Sets how slides change when presenting, or none with nil.

methods.sig: addTextBox(slide: string, x: double, y: double, w: double, h: double, text: string): string
methods.doc: Puts a text box on a slide. Returns its id.

methods.sig: addShape(slide: string, geometry: string, x: double, y: double, w: double, h: double): string
methods.doc: Puts a shape (`rect`, `ellipse`, `rightArrow`, any preset name) on a slide. Returns its id.

methods.sig: addImage(slide: string, src: string, width: double, height: double, x: double?, y: double?): string
methods.doc: Puts a picture on a slide: `src` is a `data:` address, or a reference your storage knows. Returns its id.

methods.sig: addTable(slide: string, rows: int, columns: int): string
methods.doc: Puts an empty table on a slide. Returns its id.
Puts a sample chart on a slide (`column`, `bar`, `line`, `area`, `pie`, `doughnut`, `scatter`). Returns its id.

methods.sig: setText(slide: string, element: string, text: string): void
methods.doc: Replaces the text of a shape; line breaks start new paragraphs.

methods.sig: formatText(slide: string, ids: [string], patch: json): void
methods.doc: Formats the text of shapes: `{"bold": true, "fontSize": 24, "color": "#c00000"}`. A property set to null is removed.

methods.sig: setFrame(slide: string, element: string, x: double?, y: double?, w: double?, h: double?, rotation: double?): void
methods.doc: Moves, resizes and turns an element; a value left out stays.

methods.sig: moveBy(slide: string, ids: [string], dx: double, dy: double): void
methods.doc: Moves elements by a distance in points.

methods.sig: setFill(slide: string, ids: [string], fill: json): void
methods.doc: Fills shapes with a colour (`"#ffffff"` or `{"theme": "accent1"}`), or none with nil.
Deletes elements.
Duplicates elements, a little to the side. Returns the new ids.

methods.sig: arrange(slide: string, ids: [string], how: ArrangeHow): void
methods.doc: Changes the drawing order.

methods.sig: align(slide: string, ids: [string], how: AlignHow): void
methods.doc: Aligns elements to each other, or one element to the slide.
Groups elements. Returns the group's id.
Takes a group apart. Returns the ids of what was in it.

methods.sig: replaceAll(query: string, replacement: string, matchCase: bool?, notes: bool?): int
methods.doc: Replaces text in every slide; returns how many places changed.

methods.sig: commentOnSlide(slide: string, body: string, mentions: [string]?): Thread
methods.doc: Starts a comment thread on a slide. The thread's anchor is `{"slide": <the slide's id>}`.

methods.sig: commentOnElement(slide: string, element: string, body: string, mentions: [string]?): Thread
methods.doc: Starts a comment thread on an element of a slide. The anchor is `{"slide": …, "element": …}`.
The comment threads on a slide, or on one of its elements, oldest first.
Undoes the last step.
Does the undone step again.

files.name: importPptx
files.doc: Replaces the deck with a .pptx file. History starts again.

files.name: exportPdf
files.doc: The slides as a PDF, one page each; skipped slides are left out unless listed.

pdf.doc: A PDF: pages, annotations, form fields, text search and redaction, written back as the original file plus your changes.

PageInfo.doc: A page of the PDF. Sizes are in points.

AnnotationInfo.doc: An annotation on a page. `rect` is in page space.

SearchHit.doc: Where text was found. `rects` are one per line the match covers, in page space.

methods.doc: The pages, in order.
The annotations of a page, bottom to top.
The form fields.
The form's values by field name.
The title, author and the rest the file says about itself.
The bookmarks, as a tree.
The text of a page, in reading order.

methods.sig: search(query: string, caseSensitive: bool?, wholeWord: bool?): [SearchHit]
methods.doc: Finds text on every page.
Changes the file's information: `{"title": "Annual report"}`; null removes one.
Turns pages by 90, -90 or 180 degrees.
Takes pages out, with what is on them. The last page stays.
Moves pages so that the first lands at position `index`.
Duplicates pages; returns the new ids.

methods.sig: insertBlankPage(after: string?, width: double?, height: double?): string
methods.doc: Adds a blank page after another (the end by default), Letter size unless sized. Returns its id.

methods.sig: addHighlight(page: string, rects: json, kind: MarkupKind?, color: string?, quote: string?): string
methods.doc: Marks text with a highlight, underline or strikeout over rectangles `[{"x": 72, "y": 700, "w": 100, "h": 12}]`. Returns its id.

methods.sig: addNote(page: string, x: double, y: double, text: string): string
methods.doc: Puts a sticky note on a page. Returns its id.

methods.sig: addShape(page: string, kind: ShapeKind, x: double, y: double, w: double, h: double, color: string?): string
methods.doc: Draws a rectangle or an ellipse. Returns its id.

methods.sig: addFreeText(page: string, x: double, y: double, w: double, h: double, text: string): string
methods.doc: Puts text on a page. Returns its id.

methods.sig: addLink(page: string, x: double, y: double, w: double, h: double, uri: string): string
methods.doc: Makes a rectangle a link to a web address. Returns its id.
Changes the text of a note or free text.

methods.sig: moveAnnotations(ids: [string], dx: double, dy: double): void
methods.doc: Moves annotations by a distance in points.
Deletes annotations.
Fills a form field: text, true or false, or a list for a list box.
Fills fields by name; returns the ids of the fields that were filled.
Marks rectangles for redaction. Nothing is removed until `applyRedactions`. Returns the mark's id.
Marks every match of a search for redaction. Returns the marks' ids.
Removes what is under the marks for good, from the pages given (all by default).

methods.sig: addComment(page: string, x: double, y: double, body: string, mentions: [string]?): Thread
methods.doc: Starts a comment thread with a sticky note at a point of a page; the note's text in the file is the first comment.

methods.sig: commentOnAnnotation(annotation: string, body: string, mentions: [string]?): Thread
methods.doc: Starts a comment thread on a highlight or any other annotation.
Undoes the last step.
Does the undone step again.

files.name: exportPdf
files.doc: The PDF written back: the original file with your changes added, so what you didn't touch stays byte for byte.

files.name: importPdf
files.doc: Replaces the document with another PDF file. History starts again.
